name: Vegetable and Beef Skillet
recipeIngredient: ½ pound lean ground beef (15% fat)
¾ cup chopped onion (¾ medium onion)
1 can (15 ounces) diced tomatoes (about 2 medium fresh tomatoes)
1½ cups vegetables, fresh, frozen, or canned and drained (zucchini, bell pepper, broccoli, corn, cauliflower)

recipeInstructions.text: Cook beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until no longer pink. Drain fat.
recipeInstructions.name: Cook the beef

recipeInstructions.text: Add onion and cook until soft, about 3 to 5 minutes.
recipeInstructions.name: Add the onion

recipeInstructions.text: Add rice, tomatoes, vegetables, water and spices. Stir and bring to a boil.
recipeInstructions.name: Combine ingredients

recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to medium low. Cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add more water if needed.
recipeInstructions.name: Simmer the mixture

recipeInstructions.text: Remove from heat. Sprinkle with cheese and cover for 1 to 2 minutes to allow cheese to melt. Serve warm.
recipeInstructions.name: Add cheese

description: A hearty and nutritious meal featuring lean ground beef, rice, and a variety of vegetables, topped with melted cheese.
